register: यह हिंदी की वह सहज और स्वाभाविक शैली है जो आज उत्तर भारत के समाचारपत्रों, टेलीविज़न और आम बातचीत में बोली और समझी जाती है, जिसमें संस्कृत के भारी शब्दों के बजाय आम बोलचाल के शब्दों और उर्दू के प्रचलित रूपों का खुलकर उपयोग किया गया है।
narrative_voice: प्रथम पुरुष (मैं), भूतकाल और वर्तमान काल का मिला-जुला रूप, जिसकी बनावट तीखी, आत्मविश्लेषी और तनाव से भरी हुई है; इसके लिए हिंदी की सीधी और धारदार कथात्मक शैली उपयुक्त है।

characters.name: Theo
characters.notes: Determined, obsessive, clinical yet personally vulnerable. Speaks with professional care that occasionally slips into emotional edge.

characters.name: Alicia Berenson
characters.notes: Silent, traumatized, intensely observant. Her diary entries are direct, raw, and unpretentious.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.notes: Successful fashion photographer, charming, occasionally dismissive. Speaks with casual warmth and occasional irritation.

characters.name: Diomedes
characters.notes: Cynical, experienced, amused by amateur enthusiasm. Speaks with authority and dry wit.

characters.name: Kathy
characters.notes: Actress, exhausted, distant, sharp-tongued. Speaks with casual weariness and directness.

characters.name: Stephanie
characters.notes: Rigid, bureaucratic, protective of her domain. Formal and defensive.

characters.name: Christian
characters.notes: Skeptical, dismissive, arrogant. Speaks with absolute certainty about others' failures.

characters.name: Jean-Felix
characters.notes: Artsy, articulate, slightly evasive. Speaks with confident familiarity.

characters.name: Barbie
characters.notes: Gossipy, dramatic, self-absorbed. Uses colloquial, expressive language.

characters.name: Paul
characters.notes: Nostalgic, unsettling, unburdened by tact. Speaks with rustic earthiness.

formality_matrix.why: Professional distance initially, evolving into respectful clinical address.
Senior mentor addressing a younger colleague with paternal familiarity.
Not directly interacting, but conceptualized with professional/social respect if ever addressed.
Professional peer boundary in public dispute.
Polite professional curiosity toward an outsider.
Cautious distance with a stranger/relative from the past.

glossary.why: Name of the psychiatric unit; must remain fixed as a proper noun in transliteration.
Central mythological motif representing sacrifice, silence, and betrayal.
Key thematic motif representing trauma and refusal to speak.

pitfalls: Over-Sanskritizing psychological terms like 'transference' or 'psychotic' instead of using accepted everyday clinical loanwords used in Indian hospitals and therapy (ट्रांसफ़रेंस, साइकोटिक).
Falling into archaic Hindi grammatical constructions in the narration while trying to keep it 'literary'.
Failing to maintain the distinct spoken texture of secondary characters like Barbie and Paul against the clinical detachment of Theo.
